---
name: Research correction
about: A number, citation, or claim in the skill does not match its source
title: "[research] "
labels: research
---

## Claim as written

Quote it, with the file path.

## Source

Which paper, and where in it. Quote the source sentence if you can.

## The discrepancy

Wrong number, wrong denominator, wrong direction, overreach, or a finding attributed to the wrong paper.

## Suggested correction

One sentence. If the claim should be removed rather than fixed, say so.
